markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, cross-model consensus, and 0% invasive risk across all 12 regions support routine tier-4 priority.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, InSitu 0%, Normal 0%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Strong benign score, 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% target (90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Atypical vs calibration, no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign (77%–82% similarity) [F5] | Nearest reference cases all benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 5, 7) · ↓ invasive · High score (1.44; -1.08 contribution) pushes away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · High text score (2.16; -0.98 contribution); caption check conflicted [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 5, 10) · context · Elevated score (1.24; -0.85 contribution); 8/20 AI spot check [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.28; -0.77 contribution) opposes stromal invasion · Validated
- **Nuclear and immune morphometry** (regions 9, 10, 11) · context · 5th-percentile size [F7]; 93rd–100th-percentile size/shape variation [F8, F9], 28% immune [F10] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (removing top 3 risk regions beats random by +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); case weights unreliable normal lobules (+0.64, 0/20) and mitoses (-0.49, 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High nuclear size/shape variation and 13–15 neoplastic nuclei per region in regions 9–11 reflect ductal atypia or InSitu.
- Dense inflammation in regions 4, 5, and 10 (42 inflammatory cells in region 10) obscures focal atypical epithelium.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 10, 11**: Inspect nuclei driving 93rd–100th-percentile size/shape variation and check region 9 for duct-confined atypia.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 10**: Review dense lymphocytic infiltrate (42 inflammatory cells in region 10) for obscured epithelium.
3. **Regions 1, 4, 5, 7, 8**: Confirm benign stroma/fat and tubules (caption check conflicted on tubule formation).
